title: Neuroprotective effects of Chaihu-Longgu-Muli Decoction in an insomnia-depression comorbidity model via Galectin-3-dependent JAK2/STAT3 inhibition.
authors: Li, Zhujiang; Zhang, Kairui; Zhang, Zhuo; Jiang, Jiecheng; Ji, Shiyu; Li, Yaqi; Wu, Yixuan; Zhang, Zefeng; Qiao, Peipei; Yu, Mingyu; Xiang, Mengyuan; Huang, Panpan
one_liner_zh: 该文研究中药复方通过Galectin-3/JAK2/STAT3通路改善失眠-抑郁共病的神经保护机制，虽含分子对接但核心为湿实验与信号通路，非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Chaihu-Longgu-Muli Decoction (CLMD) is a classical Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) formula from the Shanghan Lun comprising Bupleureum chinense DC., Os Draconis, Concha Ostreae, and the other herbs. Traditionally used to harmonize Shaoyang, calm Shen (spirit), and treat emotional disturbances and insomnia related to liver qi stagnation. AIM OF THE STUDY: To evaluate CLMD's therapeutic efficacy in insomnia-depression comorbidity and elucidate molecular mechanisms through bioinformatics and experimental validation. MATERIALS AND METHODS: Differentially expressed genes were identified from the GEO database, and key targets were screened using machine-learning approaches. Functional enrichment and single-cell analyses were performed to explore biological relevance. Molecular docking was used to assess compound target interactions. A mouse model of insomnia-depression comorbidity was established using chronic unpredictable mild stress combined with sleep deprivation, followed by CLMD treatment and behavioral evaluation. In addition, in vitro experiments were conducted in astrocytes with Galectin-3 (Gal-3) overexpression to further investigate the underlying mechanisms. RESULTS: Bioinformatics identified Gal-3 as the core target, and KEGG/GSEA highlighted JAK2/STAT3 signaling. Docking indicated strong binding of major CLMD constituents to Gal-3. In a CUMS plus sleep deprivation mouse model, CLMD improved depressive-like behaviors and sleep architecture, reduced Gal-3/JAK2/p-STAT3 expression, and regulated inflammatory and neurochemical markers. In vitro, CLMD improved cell viability, reduced apoptosis and ROS, and suppressed Gal-3-induced JAK2/STAT3 activation. CONCLUSIONS: CLMD alleviates insomnia-depression comorbidity by inhibiting Gal-3-mediated JAK2/STAT3 signaling, reducing neuroinflammation and enhancing neuroprotection.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：柴胡龙骨牡蛎汤（CLMD）是源自《伤寒论》的经典中药方剂，由柴胡（Bupleureum chinense DC.）、龙骨、牡蛎及其他草药组成。传统上用于和解少阳、安神（宁心），并治疗与肝气郁结相关的情绪障碍和失眠。研究目的：评估CLMD在失眠-抑郁共病中的治疗效果，并通过生物信息学和实验验证阐明其分子机制。材料与方法：从GEO数据库识别差异表达基因，并使用机器学习方法筛选关键靶点。进行功能富集和单细胞分析以探索生物学相关性。采用分子对接评估化合物-靶点相互作用。通过慢性不可预知轻度应激结合睡眠剥夺建立失眠-抑郁共病小鼠模型，随后进行CLMD治疗和行为学评估。此外，在过表达半乳糖凝集素-3（Galectin-3, Gal-3）的星形胶质细胞中进行体外实验，以进一步研究潜在机制。结果：生物信息学分析确定Gal-3为核心靶点，KEGG/GSEA分析突出JAK2/STAT3信号通路。对接结果表明CLMD主要成分与Gal-3有强结合。在CUMS加睡眠剥夺小鼠模型中，CLMD改善了抑郁样行为和睡眠结构，降低了Gal-3/JAK2/p-STAT3表达，并调节了炎症和神经化学标志物。体外实验中，CLMD提高了细胞活力，减少了凋亡和活性氧（ROS），并抑制了Gal-3诱导的JAK2/STAT3激活。结论：CLMD通过抑制Gal-3介导的JAK2/STAT3信号通路，减轻神经炎症并增强神经保护，从而缓解失眠-抑郁共病。
